programme.desc: New York lawyer Vinny has never won a case. When his teenage cousin Bill and his friend Stan are accused of murder in a backwater Alabama town, it's up to the nervous Vinny to save him from jail, even though he's only ever tried personal injury cases before, and none of them successfully.

programme.title: Step Brothers
programme.desc: Brennan Huff (Will Ferrell) and Dale Doback (John C. Reilly) have one thing in common: they are both lazy, unemployed leeches who still live with their parents. When Brennan's mother and Dale's father marry and move in together, it turns the overgrown boys' world upside down. Their insane rivalry and narcissism pull the new family apart, forcing them to work together to reunite their parents.

programme.title: Meet the Parents

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.desc: La plus grosse tornade jamais enregistrée menace de ravager une petite ville, laissant aux habitants seulement 13 minutes pour trouver un abri, rechercher leurs proches et lutter pour leur vie. programme.title: À la recherche de
programme.desc: Zach explore le monde sombre du contrôle de l'esprit; il rencontre une victime qui s'est fait implanter un appareil de harcèlement dans la tête et le cou; il examine les récentes attaques sonores contre des diplomates américains à Cuba.

programme.title: Mythes et légendes de la Grande-Bretagne
programme.desc: Andy rejoint une équipe d'experts et de bénévoles spécialisés dans Nessie; à l'aide d'équipements dernier cri, il va mener avec eux la plus grande recherche depuis 50 ans et révéler de nouvelles preuves qui pourraient enfin prouver son existence.

programme.title: Les plus grands mystères de l'histoire
programme.desc: Au cours de l'Histoire, certains mystères ont déchaîné les passions; dans cette série, une équipe d'experts internationaux va démêler la science de la fiction; grâce à eux, vous allez remonter le temps et revivre des enquêtes controversées.

programme.title: Avec ou sans cash
programme.desc: Geneviève et Guillaume visitent Lyon, la capitale gastronomique de la France ; au menu, il y a un atelier de cuisine consacré au pâté en croûte, dégustations dans les Halles de Lyon Paul Bocuse et une visite guidée des traboules lyonnaises.

programme.title: Avec ou sans cash
programme.desc: Geneviève et Guillaume passent 24 heures à Séville en Espagne ; tandis que l'un visite un palais datant de plusieurs siècles, l'autre découvre des quartiers à l'architecture colorée. Ils se retrouvent ensuite à une soirée de flamenco.

programme.title: Avec ou sans cash
programme.desc: Guillaume et Geneviève sont envoûtés par le charme de Venise ; le riche assiste à un atelier de masques vénitiens et mange au célèbre Café Florian ; tandis que le modeste découvre l'île de Murano avec son verre soufflé et déguste des Cicchetti.

programme.title: Chasse à l'homme: marécage
programme.desc: Retour sur la scène de l'accident : une piste écartée pourrait tout changer ; tandis que certains membres de l'équipe s'impatientent et ne lâchent pas le morceau, la fatigue et les tensions montent.

programme.title: Chasse à l'homme: marécage
programme.desc: Le fugitif est proche, l'équipe ressent la pression monter: l'heure de vérité a sonné. Entre cul-de-sac et désaccords, un membre jusque-là en retrait s'impose enfin. Pas une seconde à perdre, il ne reste que quelques heures pour accomplir la mission.

programme.title: My Blind Brother
programme.desc: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize.

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams).

programme.title: Super Troopers 2
programme.desc: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear.

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her.

programme.title: Ocean's Eight
programme.desc: Debbie Ocean assembles an all-female team of thieves and specialists for a heist during the Met Gala, aiming for the $150 million worth of diamonds around the neck of world-famous actress Daphne Kluger.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises.

programme.title: Blair Witch
programme.desc: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined.

programme.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
programme.desc: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative.

programme.title: Full Metal Jacket
programme.desc: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hué.

programme.title: Despicable Me
programme.desc: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad.

programme.title: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
programme.desc: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

programme.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
programme.desc: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy.

programme.title: The Predator
programme.desc: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and a disgruntled science teacher can prevent the end of the human race.

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside.

programme.title: Catfish
programme.desc: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: Our Kind of Traitor
programme.desc: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

programme.title: Hoot
programme.desc: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

programme.title: Van Helsing
programme.desc: Un chasseur de monstres fait équipe avec une belle femme pour combattre Dracula et d'autres créatures en Transylvanie.

programme.title: Monde infernal
programme.desc: Une femme vampire tente de protéger un étudiant en médecine contre des loups-garous dont l'intention est de créer une espèce hybride.

programme.title: BloodRayne
programme.desc: Une femme mi-vampire, mi-humaine se joint à un groupe de vampires qui doivent détruire le méchant seigneur des immortels avant qu'il n'accomplisse une prophétie ancienne.

programme.title: World War Z
programme.desc: Un jour comme les autres, Gerry Lane et sa famille se retrouvent coincés dans un embouteillage monstre sur leur trajet quotidien. Ancien enquêteur des Nations Unies, Lane comprend immédiatement que la situation est inhabituelle. Tandis que les hélicoptères de la police sillonnent le ciel et que les motards quadrillent les rues, la ville bascule dans le chaos. Les gens s'en prennent violemment les uns aux autres et un virus mortel semble se propager.

programme.title: 28 semaines plus tard
programme.desc: Six mois après l'épidémie, le virus de la rage a tué presque la totalité de la population des îles britanniques. L'armée américaine ayant déclaré le danger écarté, les soldats débarquent afin de restaurer l'ordre et de commencer la reconstruction. Les réfugiés rentrent au pays, mais l'un d'eux porte le virus, toujours actif et encore plus meurtrier.

programme.title: Midsommar: solstice d'été
programme.desc: Dani et Christian forment un jeune couple dont la relation bat de l'aile. À la suite d'une tragédie familiale qui les rapproche, Dani décide d'accompagner Christian et ses amis lors d'un voyage unique au festival Midsommar dans un village éloigné en Suède. Ce qui commence par des vacances d'été sans tracas dans un pays au soleil éternel prend une tournure sinistre lorsque les villageois invitent les voyageurs à participer aux festivités qui rendent le lieu de paix de plus en plus troublant.

programme.title: Souviens-toi, notre secret l'été dernier
programme.desc: Amy passe les vacances avec ses enfants, Katie et Luke, dans une maison louée près du lac où ils vont tous les ans. Amy se lie d'amitié avec la propriétaire de la maison, Megan, ayant perdu sa famille dans un accident de voiture, un an plus tôt. Heureuse de retrouver ses amis, Katie apprend qu'ils étaient dans la voiture qui a provoqué l'accident.

programme.title: Sous l'emprise du péché
programme.desc: Une femme mariée entame une liaison passionnée avec Carlo, un artiste sombre dont le charme cache une personnalité profondément instable. Lorsqu'elle tente de rompre, il cherche à saboter sa vie et menace tout ce qu'elle a bâti.

programme.title: Casse-tête chinois
programme.desc: La vie de Xavier ne s'est pas rangée et tout semble même devenir de plus en plus compliqué. Désormais père de deux enfants, son virus du voyage l'entraîne à New York, au beau milieu du quartier chinois. Sa vie tient résolument du casse-tête chinois.

programme.title: Le piège américain
programme.desc: Un homme se retrouve impliqué dans le complot visant à assassiner le président Kennedy.

programme.title: La tête dans les nuages
programme.desc: L'approche imminente de la Seconde Guerre mondiale menace les liens qui unissent une photographe délurée, une réfugiée espagnole et un professeur londonien.

programme.title: La bataille de Passchendaele
programme.desc: En 1917, un sergent traumatisé rentré du front accepte d'y retourner afin de protéger le frère de l'infirmière dont il est amoureux.

programme.title: Escouade gangster
programme.desc: À Los Angeles en 1949, les policiers essaient d'apporter le dur et puissant mafioso Mickey Cohen à la justice.

programme.title: Les gangs de New York
programme.desc: En 1846, le quartier de Five Points, un faubourg pauvre de New York, est le théâtre d'une guerre des gangs sanguinaire. Lorsque Bill le Boucher assassine le chef des Irlandais, père d'Amsterdam Vallon, il s'associe avec un policier véreux et prend le contrôle de la ville. Seize ans plus tard, Amsterdam retourne à New York pour venger la mort de son père, tuer Bill et mettre fin à son règne.

programme.title: Le commando des bâtards
programme.desc: Dans la France occupée de 1940, Shosanna Dreyfus assiste à l'exécution de sa famille tombée entre les mains du colonel nazi Hans Landa. Shosanna s'échappe de justesse et s'enfuit à Paris où elle se construit une nouvelle identité en devenant exploitante d'une salle de cinéma. Quelque part ailleurs en Europe, le lieutenant Aldo Raine forme un groupe de soldats juifs américains pour mener des actions punitives particulièrement sanglantes contre les nazis.

programme.title: Il était une fois à... Hollywood
programme.desc: Rick Dalton, un acteur de télévision qui a déjà vécu de meilleures années, et son cascadeur de longue date Cliff Booth s'efforcent d'atteindre la gloire et le succès dans l'industrie cinématographique au cours de l'âge d'or de Hollywood en 1969. Ils viennent à la réalisation que l'industrie du spectacle n'est plus ce qu'elle était.

programme.title: À couteaux tirés
programme.desc: Lorsque le célèbre écrivain Harlan Thrombey est retrouvé mort sur son domaine après son 85e anniversaire, le détective Benoit Blanc est chargé de mener l'enquête. De la famille dysfonctionnelle au personnel dévoué, Blanc passe au crible plein de fausses pistes et de mensonges pour découvrir la vérité derrière la mort prématurée de Harlan.

programme.title: La mort vous va si bien
programme.desc: Pour être sûre de l'amour de son fiancé, Helen décide de lui faire passer l'épreuve "Madeline Ashton." Elle voue une haine tenace à cette femme qui lui a déjà soufflé plusieurs hommes. Malheureusement, Ernest succombe immédiatement aux minauderies de cette actrice sur le retour.

programme.title: Sur la route de Madison
programme.desc: En l'absence de sa famille, une femme mariée vit une passion amoureuse intense avec un photographe de passage en Iowa.

programme.title: J'ai tué ma mère
programme.desc: Hubert Minel n'aime pas sa mère. Adolescent, il la juge avec mépris, ne voit que ses pulls ringards, sa décoration kitch et les miettes de pain qui se logent à la commissure de ses lèvres quand elle mange bruyamment.

programme.title: Marie et Martha
programme.desc: Une décoratrice d'intérieur américaine et une mère au foyer anglaise, dont les fils respectifs ont été emportés par la malaria en Afrique, s'unissent dans le but de sensibiliser les autorités internationales à cette terrible maladie.

programme.title: Prise et remise
programme.desc: À la suite de la mort de son fiancé dans un accident, une jeune femme fait des découvertes étonnantes sur le passé de celui qu'elle croyait pourtant bien connaître.

programme.title: Mon passé volé
programme.desc: Victime de plusieurs accidents, Mallory a partiellement perdu la mémoire. Entourée de son mari Reese, de son petit garçon Billy et de ses amis, elle reprend le cours de sa vie, retrouvant peu à peu ses souvenirs.

programme.title: Extrême limite
programme.desc: Johnny Utah, un agent du FBI, a pour mission d'infiltrer un groupe criminel qui tente par ses actions de déstabiliser le marché mondial de la finance. Utilisant des moyens inusités pour réaliser une série de vols audacieux et spectaculaires, les membres de l'organisation sont de véritables athlètes de sports extrêmes. Après s'être illustré lors d'une épreuve de surf, Utah est accepté au sein du clan dirigé par Bodhi, avec qui il se lie d'amitié.

programme.title: Une vie de mensonges
programme.desc: L'agent de la CIA, Roger Ferris, veut capturer le terroriste Al-Saleem avec l'aide d'Ed Hoffman. Ils veulent infiltrer le groupe de terroristes d'Al-Saleem pour le capturer. Ils risqueront leurs vies avec le plan qu'ils ont inventé.

programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. programme.title: It Takes a Killer
programme.desc: Some of the world's most notorious murders are the subject of "It Takes a Killer," which investigates the crimes from the perspective of the killers, trying to get inside their minds and determine their motives. Leading homicide investigators and experts from such agencies as the FBI and Scotland Yard take a look at the evidence pulled from crime scenes and profile the killer's behavior to try to piece together the details of each murder, explaining when, why and how each criminal committed the crime. For the wannabe detectives watching the show, the experts also reveal how the crime was solved -- which often requires authorities to think like a killer.

These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life - and some with more grace than others.

programme.title: The Verdict With Judge Hatchett
programme.desc: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. programme.title: Funny You Should Ask
programme.desc: Former "Extra" correspondent Jon Kelley hosts this comedy game show that features a panel of comedians interacting with two contestants, who have a chance to win cash if they can read between the lines of the comics' jokes. The contestants ask the comedians questions, to which the jokemakers give humorous answers. The players are tasked with determining if each answer is right or wrong, earning increasingly higher amounts of money as the game progresses. The contestant who has the most money at the end of the game goes on to the bonus round to potentially earn more cash.

programme.title: Live: Hot Stove
programme.desc: Baby, it might be cold outside, and the springtime sounds of bats hitting balls are months away. What better way for baseball fans to cure the winter blues than to gather around the "Hot Stove" and warm up to the news of the offseason? MLB Network has all the angles covered for all 30 teams, from trades and free agent signings to the juicy rumors that percolate throughout, especially at the annual Winter Meetings in December. programme.title: Ridiculousness
programme.desc: Don't be ridiculous! When it comes to Internet videos run amok, however, the more zany, unbelievable and downright dangerous the clips are, the greater the chance they'll be shown on this series. It features amateur viral videos being critiqued by MTV personality Rob Dyrdek ("Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory"), who knows a thing or two about pushing the envelope from his pro skateboarding days. With commentary from Sterling "Steelo" Brim and Chanel (the rapping receptionist from "Fantasy Factory"), Dyrdek breaks down the clips by putting them in such categories as "Hot Mess," "Worst Case Scenario," "Redneck Good Times" and "What Happened Last Night." It's sure to be seriously ridiculous.

programme.title: The Guild Garage
programme.desc: In a multibillion dollar industry, the Guild of Automotive Restorers tries to get a piece of the pie by completing any task put before it. Through preservation, restoration and selling some of the world's greatest cars, the team at the Guild has gained an internationally acknowledged reputation. Owner David Granger and his crew turn rust into gold, whether a rare vintage Lancia comes in for a complete rebuild or a classic Chevy needs some "go faster" stripes. Through it all, Granger and his crew face shop-floor drama, gas-fueled egos and millions at stake.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: A look behind the scenes at how everyday things are manufactured. Typically each episode includes three to four products featured, with a mix consisting of common items such as jeans, aluminum foil and cereal, and less predictable ones like wax figurines, braille typewriters and pinball machines.

programme.title: Slo Pitch
programme.desc: As Captain of the slo pitch beer league team, the Brovaries, Joanne is determined to make this season count, but the team just can't get their act together. Joanne's hot lawyer fiancé is so bad that kicking her off the team is the only solution. Stoner-bisexual Ann is sleeping with TWO members of the Brovaries' biggest rival team, and disgraced ex pro player Mel has sunk into a deep depression. If all that wasn't enough, German beer hound Boris needs to find a wife or face imminent deportation before playoffs, and rookie Lee spends more time with her glove on her head making Tik Tok videos than catching anything. The Brovaries need to come together if they're going to make it past the drama, save a marriage, fake a marriage, and beat their rival team, The Blue Gays. There may not be any money, trophies or sponsorship deals up for grabs, but for the Brovaries, slo pitch is life or death. Well, maybe for Joanne anyway. Everyone else is just in it for the beer. And the girls.

Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. But to break the lease with the city of Cleveland, ticket sales have to plummet. So Phelps hires the most incompetent players available, including near-blind pitcher Rick Vaughn (Charlie Sheen) and injury-prone catcher Jake Taylor (Tom Berenger). But her villainous tactics accidentally foster a can-do team spirit, turning the Indians into potential winners.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad
programme.desc: At the Elmview Corrective School for Girls, the facility's warden, Mr. Riggs (Cecil Clovelly), abuses prisoners and justifies his actions as strict discipline. Dr. John H. Jason (Paul Henreid), the school's head psychologist, and Ruth Levering (Catherine McLeod), an assistant, view Riggs' actions as unethical, and believe he's driving the prisoners further toward delinquency. They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Jamie Wilson (Lloyd Bridges) concocts a risky plan for what is quickly becoming a suicide mission. With a reckless streak that has cost the lives of many men, Wilson faces the opposition of Capt. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Woman of Straw
programme.desc: Charles Richmond (Ralph Richardson), a ruthless millionaire on his deathbed, has decided to leave his entire fortune to charity. His nephew Tony (Sean Connery), who wants to get his hands on his uncle's millions, enlists a beautiful nurse named Maria (Gina Lollobrigida) to seduce and wed Charles, then inherit his wealth. Tony, who is to split the money with Maria after the old man dies, is dismayed when the young woman actually falls for Charles, and has second thoughts about the scheme.

programme.title: In the Time of the Butterflies
programme.desc: A rebel leader educates a Dominican Republic woman (Salma Hayek) about the abuses of a corrupt dictator (Edward James Olmos).

programme.title: Park Row
programme.desc: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

programme.title: Albino Alligator
programme.desc: When a robbery in New Orleans ends in disaster, the mercurial burglar Dova escapes with his cohorts to a seedy, nearby bar. Capturing all those inside, the criminals trade barbs with the establishment's feisty bartender Janet Boudreaux. The pub becomes highly volatile, however, when the police encircle it; as it turns out, they were already there surveilling another of the bar's patrons, a suspected illicit arms trafficker named Guy Foucard.

programme.title: The Limbic Region
programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession.

programme.title: Guns, Girls and Gangsters
programme.desc: A Las Vegas singer (Mamie Van Doren) plans an armored-car robbery with her husband's (Lee Van Cleef) ex-cellmate (Gerald Mohr).

programme.title: The Last Time I Saw Archie
programme.desc: As World War II winds down, supply pilots at a stateside military base are left with few duties. Cocky Pvt. Archie Hall (Robert Mitchum) shirks even the most menial tasks by slyly leading everyone to believe he's a high-ranking officer working undercover. Alongside his buddy, Pvt. Bill Bowers (Jack Webb), Archie gets entangled with a pair of local women, Peggy (Martha Hyer) and Cindy (France Nuyen) -- one of whom might be passing secrets to the Japanese.

programme.title: If It's Tuesday, It Still Must Be Belgium
programme.desc: Tourists in Europe join their bus driver (Claude Akins) on a search for his daughter, kidnapped by a circus knife-thrower (Bruce Weitz).

programme.title: Phantom Killer
programme.desc: A district attorney (Dick Purcell) quits to prove the guilt of an acquitted killer (John Hamilton) who cannot hear or speak.

programme.title: Article 99
programme.desc: Dr. Richard Sturgess (Ray Liotta) leads a team of compassionate doctors at a veteran's hospital. Along with Drs. Morgan (Kiefer Sutherland), Handleman (Forest Whitaker) and Van Dorn (Lea Thompson), he fights to deliver adequate care to needy veterans in the face of funding cuts and a corrupt administration. To succeed, the staff may have to bend the rules and circumvent the villainous "Article 99," a bureaucratic loophole that prevents veterans from receiving the benefits they deserve.

programme.desc: A rebel leader educates a Dominican Republic woman (Salma Hayek) about the abuses of a corrupt dictator (Edward James Olmos).

programme.title: Finders Keepers
programme.desc: A British singer (Cliff Richard) and his band (Robert Morley) join spies looking for a bomb lost by a U.S. plane over Spain.

programme.title: The Shadow Returns
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) cracks a case of missing jewels, murder and plastics.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Doctor Watson (Andre Morell) meet with a certain Dr. Mortimer (Francis De Wolff), who tells them of the legend of the "hound," born out of a murder committed by Sir Hugo Baskerville centuries ago. Explaining that Sir Charles Baskerville recently died in the same location as Sir Hugo, Mortimer expresses his deep concern that Sir Henry, the heir to the Baskerville estate, will also fall prey to the evil hound's curse. Holmes sets out to investigate.

programme.title: The Snake Woman
programme.desc: A Victorian Scotland Yarder (John McCarthy) charms a doctor's daughter (Susan Travers) prone to be a cobra.

programme.title: Kingdom of the Spiders
programme.desc: Arizona farmer Walter Colby (Woody Strode) and his wife, Birch (Altovise Davis), have a problem on their hands: One of their cows was just killed by a creature, but they have no idea what the beast could have been. So they consult local vet Dr. Robert Hansen (William Shatner), who becomes puzzled and calls in scientist Diane Ashley (Tiffany Bolling). Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins.

programme.title: The Creeping Unknown
programme.desc: A British rocket scientist (Brian Donlevy) hunts an astronaut monstrously enveloped by an alien fungus.

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Copenhagen is terrorized by a prehistoric beast that has regenerated itself from a recently discovered tail segment.

programme.title: Voodoo Island
programme.desc: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors.

programme.title: The Gravedancers
programme.desc: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits.

programme.title: The Vampire and the Ballerina
programme.desc: Two ballerinas (Helene Remy, Tina Gloriani) are trapped in the castle of a vampire countess (María Luisa Rolando) and her helper.

programme.title: Hero's Island
programme.desc: After their master dies, servants Thomas (Brendan Dillon) and Devon (Kate Manx) and their children become homesteaders on a coastal island. But when Thomas is murdered by villainous settlers hoping to claim the land for themselves, Devon must raise the kids -- and fight off more attacks -- by herself. Luckily, however, she gets help from Jacob (James Mason), a mysterious shipwrecked stranger, and Nicholas (Rip Torn), a kindly sailor and slave ship escapee.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: It's the future -- 1973 -- and a rescue team is sent to fetch Col. Edward Carruthers (Marshall Thompson), the lone survivor of the first manned flight to Mars. Though he's slated for the firing squad after ostensibly murdering his entire crew, he insists that a Martian monster is to blame for the deaths. Cmdr. Van Heusen (Kim Spalding) and the team doubt Carruthers' claims, until more mysterious killings occur. To their horror, they realize the bloodthirsty beast is on board the ship with them.

programme.title: Revenge of the Zombies
programme.desc: Scott Warrington (Mauritz Hugo) returns to his childhood home in Louisiana after learning that his deceased sister, Lila (Veda Ann Borg), may have been poisoned. He brings a detective (Robert Lowery) with him, and they switch identities to protect Scott. At first, they find only Lila's sad husband, Dr. von Altermann (John Carradine). Secretly, however, von Altermann is a Nazi who has been perfecting a way to turn the dead, including Lila, into an army of zombies who will serve Hitler.

Eventually, the duo discovers that oversize spiders are invading the small town, putting the entire population in danger as a county fair begins.

programme.title: The Creeping Unknown
programme.desc: A British rocket scientist (Brian Donlevy) hunts an astronaut monstrously enveloped by an alien fungus.

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Copenhagen is terrorized by a prehistoric beast that has regenerated itself from a recently discovered tail segment.

programme.title: Voodoo Island
programme.desc: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

programme.title: The Woman in the Window
programme.desc: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

programme.title: The Man in the Net
programme.desc: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

programme.title: The Neanderthal Man
programme.desc: A scientist (Robert Shayne) turns his maid into an ape-woman, his cat into a tiger and himself into an ape-man.

programme.title: The Screaming Skull
programme.desc: A man (John Hudson) tries to drive his second wife (Peggy Webber) mad at his dead first wife's Southern mansion.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Lorsque la firme de Bull aide une jeune femme à se battre avec une poursuite de brevet de médicament, ils sont forcés de se rendre à Callisto, une petite ville du Texas où Bull a souffert de sa plus grande défaite en carrière.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Lorsque les parents bien nantis d'une femme ayant été assassinée approchent Bull dans le but de poursuivre le fiancé de leur fille pour le crime, ce dernier refuse une importante somme d'argent en choisissant de représenter le fiancé en question.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Bull doit trouver une façon de renverser l'effet négatif que son client, un chirurgien égocentrique poursuivi pour une faute professionnelle, a sur les membres du jury.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: L'enlèvement d'une femme à son domicile pousse l'équipe à explorer le jardin secret de la victime et de son partenaire; même si leur mariage semble parfait en apparence, les agents découvrent que chaque membre du couple a des rendez-vous secrets.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: Un jeune Afro-Américain tire accidentellement sur un policier et prend la fuite, même s'il s'agissait clairement d'un cas de légitime défense; les membres de l'équipe se retrouvent plongés au coeur d'un dilemme moral.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: L'agent spécial Leroy Jethro Gibbs, du Service d'enquêtes criminelles de la Marine, dirige un groupe chargé d'enquêter sur des crimes, allant du meurtre et de l'espionnage au terrorisme, qui comportent des preuves liées au personnel de la Marine.

programme.title: NCIS: Sydney
programme.desc: Un marin américain accusé de meurtre est assassiné; l'équipe découvre qu'il était le sujet d'un documentaire criminel, présenté sous forme de balado; elle mène l'enquête afin de déterminer si un adepte de ce type de documentaire a voulu se rendre justice lui-même.

programme.title: NCIS: origines
programme.desc: L'équipe enquête sur le meurtre d'un membre de la marine qui avait récemment été sélectionné pour une mission secrète; pendant ce temps, la vie personnelle de Wheeler est complètement bouleversée; Lala est déstabilisée par une nouvelle inattendue de la part de Vera; Gibbs et Diane ont un double rendez-vous amoureux avec Randy et son épouse.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Les membres d'une équipe enquêtent sur le meurtre d'un officier de la Marine, ne se doutant pas qu'une surprise de taille les attend.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: Harlan Emple, le bon ami vers qui Holmes se tourne quand il a besoin d'un vrai expert en mathématiques, s'illustre comme le principal suspect dans la disparition d'une femme.

programme.title: Liaison fatale
programme.desc: Dans le passé, une surprenante rencontre entraîne des conséquences mortelles, des conséquences qui changent à jamais la vie de chacun ; le sort de Dan est scellé, même s'il ne le sait pas encore.

programme.title: Meurtre sur la côte ouest
programme.desc: Les vieilles tensions refont surface à l'approche d'une réunion du secondaire; Bobby Ransome reprend une liaison avec la femme de son ancien meilleur ami, et est retrouvé mort le lendemain; tous les indices semblent accuser le mari jaloux.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Quand un entrepreneur de pompes funèbres engage Shade et Angie pour retrouver un corps disparu, ceux-ci entreprennent d'assister aux services funéraires qui se déroulent partout en ville.

programme.title: CIA
programme.desc: Colin et Bill assurent la sécurité lors d'une partie de soccer internationale; une alerte à la bombe les met à la recherche de deux joueurs disparus; quand l'enquête prend des proportions inattendues, l'équipe se tourne vers les agentes spéciales du FBI Isobel Castille et Maggie Bell pour un coup de main.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Afin de réhabiliter son nom, un quartier-maître se porte volontaire pour la cour martiale si le NCIS accepte de mener l'enquête après que son affaire pour meurtre a été rejetée à cause d'un problème de mandat.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Lorsque l'enseignant le plus aimé d'une prestigieuse école privée est accusé d'entretenir une relation inappropriée avec une étudiante, Shade et Angie sont engagés pour enquêter sur le scandale.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Une fusillade liée à un gang de rue sème la discorde entre Danny et Jamie ; pendant ce temps, Erin et Anthony n'arrivent pas à comprendre pourquoi un avocat de leur cabinet mettrait délibérément en péril un dossier impliquant le neveu d'Erin.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy et Jack entraînent le cheval d'Edwin pour les courses d'attelage, ce qui rapproche Amy et Edwin ; Logan prend en charge le cheval de son client ; la soirée de l'élection arrive pour Lou, alors que la famille est confrontée à une perte difficile.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Le directeur Vance accueille l'agent spécial Jacqueline Jack Sloane, une psychologue qu'il a fait transférer de la Californie au quartier général.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Sam et Jay sont ravis de trouver un assistant hautement qualifié pour le gîte touristique; cependant, leur nouvel employé vient avec un bagage surprenant; de plus, Thorfinn tente d'aider son fils, Bjorn, à faire face à un tyran.

programme.title: Ghosts: fantômes à la maison
programme.desc: Sam donne des conseils en matière de relations à Freddie, l'assistant de Jay, ignorant l'avertissement d'Hetty de ne pas trop s'approcher de lui; de plus, Sasappis se lie d'amitié avec Jessica, le fantôme qui vit dans la voiture de Freddie.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Cat et Vincent font face à un dur échec ; Vincent est interrogé secrètement à propos d'une attaque imminente.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Une violente explosion secoue un immeuble d'appartements à Brooklyn; l'équipe épingle rapidement le coupable, mais découvre qu'il agit sur les ordres d'un criminel actuellement derrière les barreaux; pendant ce temps, Isobel doit désigner la personne qui prendra sa relève, avant d'occuper elle-même ses nouvelles fonctions.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy et Jack entraînent le cheval d'Edwin pour les courses d'attelage, ce qui rapproche Amy et Edwin ; Logan prend en charge le cheval de son client ; la soirée de l'élection arrive pour Lou, alors que la famille est confrontée à une perte difficile.

programme.title: NCIS: Los Angeles
programme.desc: Callen et ses coéquipiers tentent de sauver un enfant qui est tombé sous la coupe d'une cellule terroriste.

programme.title: Hawaii 5-0
programme.desc: À la suite des derniers événements, le 5-0 se mobilise pour retrouver Aaron Wright, mais les vies de McGarrett et son équipe sont en danger lorsqu'une visiteuse se rend dans les locaux du 5-0 et ouvre le feu.

programme.title: Hawaii sauvetage extrême
programme.desc: Deux sauveteurs débutants tentent de se faire une place dans l'équipe chargée de surveiller et de protéger la côte nord d'O'ahu, à Hawaii; Sonny et sa famille pleurent toujours la perte de son neveu Zion; le passé romantique d'Em et Will est révélé.

programme.title: Hawaii sauvetage extrême
programme.desc: Lorsqu'une crue soudaine emporte une jeune touriste loin de sa famille et en haute mer, Sonny, Em et Will se précipitent pour la sauver ; allant à l'encontre des souhaits de Sonny, Em prend un risque audacieux, mettant sa propre vie en danger.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: L'équipe doit retrouver un tireur ciblant des détectives oeuvrant au sein du même quartier et du même poste de police; les agents de la police de New York mettent énormément de pression sur l'équipe afin que l'enquête soit rapidement bouclée.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: Une équipe est à la recherche de deux frères déterminés à se venger des membres d'une entreprise qui a causé des torts irréparables, sur le plan environnemental, à leur ville.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Lors d'une entrevue avec le premier ministre, un journaliste est blessé par balle; tout le monde soupçonne alors une tentative de meurtre; cependant, lorsque l'assassin est lui-même pris pour cible, l'équipe découvre un complot beaucoup plus complexe; pendant ce temps, OA peine à faire comprendre à Gemma les dangers liés à son métier.

programme.title: CIA
programme.desc: Un satellite contenant des matières nucléaires dangereuses s'écrase, puis disparaît; Gina se lance dans une mission d'infiltration afin d'aider Bill et Colin à recruter un ancien trafiquant d'armes qui pourrait retracer le satellite.

programme.title: FBI: International
programme.desc: L'agent spécial adjoint Jubal Valentine (FBI) se rend à Budapest pour aider personnellement l'équipe de la division internationale du FBI et la CIA à démanteler le cartel qui a assassiné son ancienne petite amie et collègue.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Mac et Riley espèrent pouvoir arrêter Codex de l'intérieur; leur mission est interrompue lorsque Russ et Desi interviennent pour empêcher Codex de faire exploser une arme de destruction massive.

programme.title: Élémentaire
programme.desc: La tension monte entre Watson et Holmes quand un ancien ami de ce dernier semble être le tueur en série qui vient tout juste de faire une autre victime et sur lequel ils enquêtent.

programme.title: Liaison fatale
programme.desc: Deux personnes dont Alex a été incapable d'accepter la gentillesse et l'aide présentent leur vision d'Alex et de sa vie, avant sa rencontre avec Dan ; puis, le monde de Dan s'écroule autour de lui : il est arrêté pour le meurtre d'Alex.

programme.title: FBI: recherchés
programme.desc: L'équipe s'efforce d'attraper celui qui menace de faire exploser une bombe à Manhattan ; pendant ce temps, Ray se prépare à célébrer une étape importante de sa vie à l'approche de son mariage avec Cora.

programme.title: Détectives privés
programme.desc: Shade et Angie sont appelés à enquêter sur un cadet de l'armée porté disparu; ils découvrent alors un lourd secret partagé entre le soldat disparu et ses deux amis; en parallèle, Angie découvre que Ken a toujours la bague de leurs fiançailles.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: Abigail est déconcertée d'apprendre qu'un jeune couple désire faire annuler une adoption ; elle découvre que le bébé en question a de graves problèmes de santé et que c'est le père adoptif qui a convaincu son épouse de l'abandonner.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Dans l'espoir d'épargner à une famille une nouvelle tragédie, la Secrétaire de la Marine demande au NCIS d'aider un marin qui se bat contre une leucémie à trouver un donneur de moelle osseuse après la mort de ses frères.

programme.title: Bête noire
programme.desc: C'est au tour de Pascale de raconter sa version des faits lors de son procès; s'ensuit le témoignage d'Éliane, qui livre un portrait touchant de sa patiente; Boisvert trouve un moyen de mettre la main sur l'ADN du présumé père biologique de Pascale.

programme.title: Blue Bloods
programme.desc: Erin et Anthony sont en désaccord quant à la procédure à adopter quand Sophia, la fille d'Anthony, s'avère être le seul témoin d'une fusillade mortelle.

programme.title: Heartland
programme.desc: Amy aide Caleb avec le poney de son fils ; Lou et Jessica se lancent dans une nouvelle entreprise, tandis que Katie s'essaie à un nouveau passe-temps risqué ; Logan fait un grand pas dans sa relation avec Miley, mais un désastre survient.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Après que Reeves soit témoin de l'enlèvement de son ami, l'équipe du NCIS découvre que le principal suspect a disparu deux jours plus tôt avec des informations militaires confidentielles; une photo embarrassante de McGee fait fureur.

programme.title: La famille fait loi
programme.desc: Abigail est déconcertée d'apprendre qu'un jeune couple désire faire annuler une adoption ; elle découvre que le bébé en question a de graves problèmes de santé et que c'est le père adoptif qui a convaincu son épouse de l'abandonner.

programme.title: La belle et la bête
programme.desc: Vincent et Cat sont prêts à faire l'ultime sacrifice pour sauver leurs amis et le monde une fois pour toutes.

programme.title: FBI
programme.desc: Deux jurés d'un procès contre la mafia sont abattus; l'équipe se lance dans une enquête sur le crime organisé; l'affaire prend une tournure personnelle pour Scola lorsqu'il apprend qu'un de ses anciens instructeurs pourrait être impliqué.

programme.title: Heartland

A photo of U.S. servicemen raising the flag on Mount Suribachi becomes an iconic symbol of victory to a war-weary nation. The individuals themselves become heroes, though not all survive the war and realize it.

Eventually however, he comes to realize that they have more in common than he first thought and that Joyce's wisdom might be just what he needs.

programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in.
